title: Fluorescence-enhanced BINOL-hybridized ladder-type siloxanes and their sensing of Fe3+
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17305-17309
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00896H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Keqian Zou, Rongrong He, Lizhong Zeng, Yujia Liu, Zheng Xu, Masafumi Unno, Liwen Xu, Zhanjiang Zheng
The fluorescence phenomenon of ladderization-induced emission enhancement (LIEE) was demonstrated in this study. The ladder-type siloxanes synthesized were able to selectively recognize Fe3+ through a quenching process.
